title: Active–Passive Voice & Direct–Indirect Speech (ಹಂತ ಹಂತದ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆ)
content:
KEA ಯ 3–4 ಖಚಿತ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ

✦ Passive Voice – ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಯ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ

• ಮೂಲ ಸೂತ್ರ: Active: Subject + Verb + Object → Passive: Object + be + V3 + (by + Subject). ನಾಲ್ಕು ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ: (1) Object ಅನ್ನು ಮುಂದೆ ತನ್ನಿ; (2) ಕಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕ 'be' ರೂಪ ಹಾಕಿ; (3) ಮುಖ್ಯ verb ಅನ್ನು V3 ಮಾಡಿ; (4) Subject ಅನ್ನು by ಜೊತೆ ಕೊನೆಗೆ (ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದ್ದರೆ). ಉದಾ: 'Rama writes a letter' → 'A letter is written by Rama'.
• ಕಾಲವಾರು 'be' ರೂಪದ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕ: Simple Present: is/am/are + V3 (is written); Present Continuous: is/am/are being + V3 (is being written); Present Perfect: has/have been + V3 (has been written); Simple Past: was/were + V3 (was written); Past Continuous: was/were being + V3; Past Perfect: had been + V3; Simple Future: will be + V3 (will be written); Future Perfect: will have been + V3; Modal: can/may/must be + V3 (can be done). ಗಮನಿಸಿ: Present/Past Perfect Continuous ಮತ್ತು Future Continuous ಗೆ passive ಇಲ್ಲ!
• ಉದಾಹರಣೆ ಸರಣಿ (ಎಲ್ಲ ಕಾಲ): 'She sings a song' → 'A song is sung by her'. 'They are building a house' → 'A house is being built by them'. 'He has completed the work' → 'The work has been completed by him'. 'The police caught the thief' → 'The thief was caught by the police'. 'They will announce the results' → 'The results will be announced'. 'You must obey the rules' → 'The rules must be obeyed'.
• ವಿಶೇಷ ರಚನೆಗಳು: ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾ ವಾಕ್ಯ: 'Who wrote this?' → 'By whom was this written?'; ಆಜ್ಞಾ ವಾಕ್ಯ: 'Open the door' → 'Let the door be opened'; 'Help the poor' → 'The poor should be helped' / 'Let the poor be helped'; ಎರಡು object ಇದ್ದರೆ: 'He gave me a book' → 'I was given a book by him' / 'A book was given to me by him' – ಎರಡೂ ಸರಿ.
• Passive ಗುರುತಿಸುವ/ಆಯ್ಕೆ ತಂತ್ರ: ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ (1) ಕಾಲ ಬದಲಾಗಿರಬಾರದು, (2) V3 ಇರಲೇಬೇಕು, (3) ಅರ್ಥ ಬದಲಾಗಿರಬಾರದು – ಈ ಮೂರು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿದರೆ ತಪ್ಪು ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳು ತಾವಾಗೇ ಬಿದ್ದುಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ. by me/him/them ಅನಗತ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ಬಿಡಬಹುದು ('English is spoken all over the world').

✦ Direct–Indirect Speech – ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ಪೂರ್ಣ ನಿಯಮ

• ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ 1 – Reporting verb & Conjunction: ಹೇಳಿಕೆ ವಾಕ್ಯ: said → said that ('He said that...'); said to + ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ → told + ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ('He said to me' → 'He told me that...'). ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ: asked + if/whether (Yes/No ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ) ಅಥವಾ asked + wh-ಪದ; ಆಜ್ಞೆ: ordered/commanded + to V1; ವಿನಂತಿ: requested + to V1; ಸಲಹೆ: advised + to V1; ಉದ್ಗಾರ: exclaimed with joy/sorrow.
• ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ 2 – ಕಾಲ ಹಿಂದಕ್ಕೆ (Backshift): Reporting verb past ಆದರೆ ಒಳವಾಕ್ಯದ ಕಾಲ ಒಂದು ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ ಹಿಂದೆ: Simple Present→Simple Past ('I am happy'→he was happy); Present Continuous→Past Continuous; Present Perfect→Past Perfect; Simple Past→Past Perfect ('I went'→he had gone); will→would; can→could; may→might; must→had to. ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ: ಸಾರ್ವತ್ರಿಕ ಸತ್ಯ ಬದಲಾಗದು – 'The sun rises in the east' ಹಾಗೇ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ (ಟ್ರ್ಯಾಪ್ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ!).
• ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ 3 – ಸರ್ವನಾಮ & ಸಮಯ-ಸ್ಥಳ ಪದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ: I→he/she; my→his/her; we→they; you→ಕೇಳುಗನಿಗೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ. ಸಮಯ ಪದಗಳು: now→then; today→that day; tonight→that night; yesterday→the previous day; tomorrow→the next day; last week→the previous week; next month→the following month; ago→before; here→there; this→that; these→those; come→go (ಸಂದರ್ಭಾನುಸಾರ).
• ಪೂರ್ಣ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳು: Direct: He said, 'I am reading now.' → Indirect: He said that he was reading then. • Direct: She said to me, 'I met your brother yesterday.' → Indirect: She told me that she had met my brother the previous day. • Direct: He said to her, 'Where are you going?' → Indirect: He asked her where she was going (ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾ ರೂಪ ಹೋಗಿ ಹೇಳಿಕೆ ಕ್ರಮ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ – 'where was she going' ✗!). • Direct: The teacher said, 'Do your homework.' → Indirect: The teacher ordered/told us to do our homework. • Direct: He said, 'Let us go for a walk.' → Indirect: He suggested that we should go for a walk.
• ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಪರಿಶೀಲನಾ ಪಟ್ಟಿ: (1) told ನಂತರ that ಸರಿ, said ನಂತರ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಬಂದರೆ ತಪ್ಪು ('said me' ✗ → 'told me'); (2) asked ನಂತರ ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾ ಕ್ರಮ (verb ಮೊದಲು) ಬಂದರೆ ತಪ್ಪು; (3) Yes/No ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗೆ if/whether ಇದೆಯೇ; (4) ಕಾಲ–ಸರ್ವನಾಮ–ಸಮಯ ಪದ ಮೂರೂ ಬದಲಾಗಿದೆಯೇ – ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಉತ್ತರ ಪಕ್ಕಾ.

★ Exam Key Points

• Passive ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಷ್: Object+be+V3+by; ಕಾಲ ಬದಲಿಸಬೇಡಿ; ಆಜ್ಞೆ→Let...be+V3; Who→By whom; Perfect Continuous ಗೆ passive ಇಲ್ಲ.
• Speech ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಷ್: said to→told; Yes/No→if/whether; now→then; yesterday→the previous day; tomorrow→the next day; ಸಾರ್ವತ್ರಿಕ ಸತ್ಯ ಬದಲಾಗದು; will→would, can→could, must→had to.

◆ ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಷ್ ಸರಪಳಿ

V3 Passive ಗುರುತು◆4 ಪರಿವರ್ತನಾ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ◆if Yes/No ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಸೇತು◆that ಹೇಳಿಕೆ ಸೇತು
